blocks.text: Grammy-award winning artist Bruno Mars is grieving the loss of his father, Peter Hernandez, who died at the age of 74. Mars confirmed Hernandez’s death through a tribute he shared on his Instagram page on Friday, Nov. 20. The cause of death was not immediately disclosed. The post included a photo of the singer embracing his father, who was lying in a hospital bed.
